newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian stocks capture modest gains at open.
newsitem.headline: Australian stocks capture modest gains at open.

text.p: The Australian share market captured modest gains at the open on Wednesday with continuing firmness on Wall Street providing an upbeat tone for local investors otherwise preoccupied with the upcoming Wallis report.
The much awaited report into Australia's financial system is due to be released at midday (0200 GMT) and brokers expect a strong focus on the bank sector following the report's release.
The All Ordinaries index added 8.1 points to 2,377.0.
"If the recommendations are there you should see the banking sector surge in the afternoon after any announcement," said a dealer at a Sydney-based brokerage.
Volumes were light early with a pre-opening trade of 4.6 million News Corp shares inflating overall turnover.
Brokers expected only subdued activity likely ahead of the Wallis report's release.

Featuring early was Perth casino operator Burswood Property Trust which said on Tuesday it was to rearrange its corporate structure and casino management agreement. Its units rose 21 cents to A$1.52 (US$1.19) on turnover of 4.1 million units.
Rises outnumbered falls by a ratio of about two to one, while about 42 percent of stocks traded remained steady.
